rappel_detail.anchor: fixed slings on a tree (not bolted)
rappel_detail.station: From the dead-tree notch atop the couloir, downclimb a short, exposed stretch to the tree carrying fixed rappel slings.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, just over 100 ft back down into the Zipper: two ropes, or a 70 m rope folded double in a high-snow year.
hazards: A single 60 m rope folded double does not reach the base.

set.rappels: 1 rappel of just over 100 ft from a slung tree below the dead-tree notch back into the couloir; two ropes, or a 70 m in a high-snow year
